prompts.text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 3D creature source concept, OpenAI bakeoff candidate A
Primary request: Create a completely new original design for the SoulDrifter Level 1 base Breachling, preserving the established species identity but not copying any existing mesh or image.
Scene/backdrop: seamless neutral light-gray studio background with soft contact shadow only
Subject: one complete nightmare predator about four feet tall. Its permanent resting anatomy is a low stalking hunch: wiry torso and spine hinged forward roughly forty degrees from a rear-set pelvis, pronounced rounded predatory upper-back arch, shoulder girdle forward of and slightly higher than the hips, projecting neck, and a large low head held well ahead of the chest. Disproportionately long forearms that nearly reach the ground; exactly four clawed fingers per hand; short powerful bent digitigrade hind legs; low hocks; broad stable feet; exactly four toes per foot; narrow angular nonhuman skull; swept-back ear fins; deep-set amber eyes; huge hinged predator maw with a deep oral cavity, multiple irregular teeth, and a visible tongue. One long muscular counterbalance tail grows continuously from the sacrum and tapers naturally. Small bony ridges run from shoulders down spine into the tail.
Materials: pale ash-gray living reptilian scales with muted teal fissure mottling, charcoal ridge and claw tips, realistic layered micro-scales, slick slithery wet skin, controlled oily highlights, physically plausible roughness variation, translucent moisture in the mouth, no baked magic lighting
Pose: neutral symmetric custom creature-rig stance while preserving the low crouch; limbs separated from torso; hands open and off the floor; joints clearly readable; feet planted; tail fully visible and separated from legs
Style/medium: premium realistic dark-fantasy creature design rendered like a high-end practical maquette and digital sculpt; frightening nightmare realism; dense close-up surface detail suitable to guide an 8K PBR source sculpt
Composition/framing: exact front orthographic-style view, complete creature fully inside frame, generous empty margin on every side, entire tail and all extremities visible, centered, no cropping
Safety: explicitly non-sexual and non-NSFW. Continuous neutral scaled hide covers chest, pelvis, groin, underside, and rear. No visible genitals, sexual organs, nipples, breasts, buttock emphasis, suggestive anatomy, or sexualized pose. No gore or exposed viscera.
Constraints: one subject only; original design; no clothing; no manufactured armor; no weapon; no wings; no separate horns beyond small natural cranial/ridge structures; no extra limbs, duplicate parts, fused fingers, floating geometry, pedestal, scenery, text, UI, logo, watermark, collage, turntable, inset, or second pose. Show the complete asset fully inside the frame with generous empty margin on every side.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production 3D creature source concept, OpenAI bakeoff candidate B
Primary request: Create a second completely new original interpretation of the SoulDrifter Level 1 base Breachling. It must remain unmistakably the same established species family while exploring a more nightmarish slick, semi-aquatic reptile/insect predator surface language. Do not copy any existing mesh or image and do not reproduce candidate A.
Scene/backdrop: seamless neutral light-gray studio background with restrained contact shadow only
Subject: one complete compact predator about four feet tall in its permanent low hunting posture. Rear-set pelvis; wiry forward-hinged torso; high rounded shoulder arch; shoulder girdle clearly forward and above hips; long projecting neck; low angular head far ahead of the chest. Extremely long but believable forearms nearly touch the floor; exactly four articulated clawed fingers per hand. Short powerful folded digitigrade hind legs with low hocks, broad stable heel pads, and exactly four clawed toes per foot. Narrow wedge-shaped skull with swept-back membrane-like ear fins, deep amber eyes, enormous hinged maw, irregular layered needle teeth, dark oral cavity, and muscular tongue. A single long flexible muscular counterbalance tail grows continuously from the sacrum, curves clear of both legs, and tapers to a whip-like end. Small flexible bony/keratin ridges continue from shoulders along spine and tail.
Materials: pale ash-gray overlapping micro-scales mixed with subtle slick pebbled hide, muted teal mineral mottling within skin creases, charcoal claws/ridges, highly realistic wet slithery surface, thin mucus-like moisture sheen without slime strings, controlled specular highlights, strong micro-normal detail, believable roughness changes, moist mouth and tongue, no baked magic glow
Pose: neutral symmetric animation-source stance that preserves the natural crouch; limbs separated; hands open and off floor; elbows, wrists, shoulders, hips, knees, hocks, jaw hinge, and tail root clearly readable; feet fully planted
Style/medium: premium photoreal dark-fantasy creature sculpt, disturbing nightmare biology, practical-effects realism combined with modern digital creature art, dense detail suitable to guide a high-resolution sculpt and 8K PBR source material
Composition/framing: exact front orthographic-style view, centered, full creature and full tail inside frame, generous clear margin on every side, no cropping
Safety: explicitly non-sexual and non-NSFW. Continuous neutral scales and hide cover chest, pelvis, groin, underside, and rear. No visible genitals, sexual organs, nipples, breasts, buttock emphasis, suggestive anatomy, or sexualized pose. No gore, exposed flesh, or viscera.
Constraints: one isolated subject only; original design; no clothing, worn armor, weapon, wings, manufactured parts, extra limbs, duplicate parts, fused digits, floating geometry, pedestal, scene, text, UI, logo, watermark, collage, turntable, inset, or second pose. Show the complete asset fully inside the frame with generous empty margin on every side.

Edit the provided SoulDrifter Breachling candidate only to correct production anatomy and source framing.

Preserve unchanged: the same creature identity, low hunched silhouette, pale ash-gray and muted teal wet micro-scaled material, swept ear fins, face, eyes, huge mouth, proportions, neutral light-gray studio background, lighting, front view, and nightmare-realistic quality.

Required corrections:
- Each hand must have exactly four total digits, counting the thumb-like inner digit: three forward fingers plus one inner thumb, all separated and clearly readable.
- Each foot must have exactly four total toes, all separated and clearly readable.
- Keep exactly one tail. Repose the tail into a low natural counterbalance curve extending sideways behind the creature at hip height or below, fully separated from both legs, with the full tail and tip visible. It must not arch above the creature, loop over the back or head, form a circle, or cross the torso silhouette.
- Keep the complete creature fully inside frame with generous margin; no cropping.
- Maintain explicitly non-sexual neutral scaled coverage: no visible genitals, sexual organs, nipples, breasts, buttock emphasis, or suggestive anatomy.
- No extra limbs, duplicate parts, fused digits, floating geometry, text, watermark, collage, or second pose.

Change only the digit counts and tail pose; preserve everything else.
